messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v2.14 -> traffic 10% in eu-west. watch: /deploys/v2.14
sam_oncall: seeing elevated 502/503 from the canary group, just noticed ~90s ago. pinging infra.
maria_sre: confirmed crashloops on encoder pods in canary-1 (OOMKilled). logs show repeated allocation spikes.
jess_prod: rolling out a non-memory change in the same chart, hmm.
ryan_eng: sharing logs snippet:
```
encoder: allocation failed: requested 4.2Gi but only 3.9Gi available
stack: gpu-allocator.cpp:142
```
sam_oncall: HPA spiked to 6 pods, but pods stuck CrashLoopBackOff; node pressure increasing, autoscaler not evicting yet.
ops-bot: Alert: 503 spike detected -> 4.8% of requests in eu-west over last 5m. Incident severity S2. Paging team.
jess_prod: can we flip the feature flag for the new encoder path? /flag toggle enc_new_path=false
maria_sre: trying the flag kill-switch now (ui + API). if that fails we'll abort rollout.
sam_oncall: customer-impact: CS reports increased latency and some 5xx for EU customers — scoped to API surface /generate only. ETA on flag change?
ryan_eng: flag change applied, propagating to canary pods; restarting canary pods now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/encoder-canary -n prod-eu`
ops-bot: @sam_oncall @maria_sre observed drop in 5xx to ~1.2% within 60s after restart. but a couple pods still CrashLoopBackOff.
jess_prod: If remaining canary pods fail, we should abort traffic and start a rollback to v2.13. Recommend abort at 0s: set traffic=0.
maria_sre: agreeing, preparing rollback plan. marking nodes: node-enc-07 shows high memory fragmentation, cordon candidate.
sam_oncall: starting abort: setting canary traffic -> 0% (router API call).
deploy-bot: Canary traffic set to 0% for v2.14. Rolling back canary pods to v2.13 image.
ryan_eng: kicked off `kubectl set image` for encoder deployment back to v2.13. Monitoring pod restarts.
ops-bot: Observability: 5xxs returned to baseline (0.2%) across EU in ~3m. No increase in global error budget.
customer-success: Logged affected customers and notified enterprise accounts with a brief note. No confirmed data loss; session retries hit.
maria_sre: manual mitigation: drained node-enc-07 to move workloads off flaky host. `kubectl drain node-enc-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` in progress.
sam_oncall: handoff: I'll rotate to post-rollback watch for 30m then hand to maria for follow-up. tagging postmortem owners: @jess_prod and @ryan_eng.
jess_prod: creating a quick revert PR to pin chart to v2.13 and remove feature flag cutover until memory fix is merged.
ops-bot: Incident closed to active paging. Please open a postmortem when stable.
maria_sre: will file postmortem, include heap traces, node fragmentation metrics, and rollouts timeline. assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
sam_oncall: thanks team. if any lingering 5xx reappears ping oncall. :thumbsup:
